# Doctors and Staff

---

## Meet Charleston GI Doctors

At Charleston GI, our medical team includes 10 outstanding board-certified gastroenterologists, with a combined experience of treating patients that exceeds 100 years. Our Physician Assistants each hold certification in their specialized field and update their skills regularly through continued education and training.

While Physician Assistants do not perform procedures, they offer a lot of value and direction for treatment. They provide additional medical care to ensure your concerns are addressed quickly. This proven approach is taken to accommodate both your schedule and our gastroenterologists.

Schedule an appointment 5 days a week, no referral needed! Charleston GI doctors are here to help!

In addition, our friendly, knowledgeable office medical staff are dedicated to managing your healthcare needs. From stomach, intestinal and digestive matters, our medical team strive in ensuring the best overall gastroenterology experience.

That is a higher standard of caring. That is Charleston GI.

# Referring Physicians

---

Choosing Charleston GI

---

Charleston GI is the largest independent gastroenterology practice in the Lowcountry, dedicated to efficient, comprehensive care – from diagnosis to treatment.

Our four convenient locations offer the most innovative technology and treatment options to patients from Beaufort to Georgetown and throughout the region. Charleston GI also operates three nationally certified and state licensed endoscopy centers.

Why Refer to Charleston GI?

---

Referring physicians trust Charleston GI, confident that their patients will not only enjoy exceptional medical care, but a warm, welcoming space, designed to put them at ease.

Our team of gastroenterologists works closely with each patient’s referring primary care physician to determine the course of treatment that best meets their needs. We believe that collaboration is necessary in providing a higher standard of caring.

Invested in the most sophisticated, up-to-date technology available, our team offers these medical and procedural specializations:

- Diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the stomach, intestine, gallbladder, liver, and pancreas
- Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS)
- Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP)
- Hemorrhoid Banding
- Capsule Endoscopy
- Colonoscopy
- Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography
- Flexible Sigmoidoscopy
- Upper Endoscopy (EGD)
- Hepatitis C
